context_notes: Planning is fully finished and committed — nothing half-written. The phase is the repo's first frontend code, so 13 of 19 files have no in-repo analog and PATTERNS.md deliberately points them at UI-SPEC/RESEARCH contract sections instead of forcing a Python analog onto them; do not 'find' an analog for those during execution. Three upstream risks are handled structurally rather than by good intentions: the staleness probe gates its dependents, DASH-05's jittered backoff is hand-rolled because mqtt.js's reconnectPeriod is a fixed interval (asserted by `grep -Ec 'reconnectPeriod: *[1-9]'` returning 0), and textContent-only is a grep-checkable acceptance criterion on all four DOM-writing modules. The one thing to resist during execution is scope creep back toward the vis-network map, CPU/RAM/disk gauges, or per-service status — all three were deliberately moved out to Phases 12/13 and 11-09/11-10 carry acceptance criteria that assert their absence.
